name: Sunshine Gravy: Fall
storyline: One fateful afternoon in 2014, Quartz Ekhesi goes on a walk to Sunshine Resort, not knowing this will be the start to the saving of Ikistar
summary: Sunshine Gravy: Fall is an upcoming platformer game where you play as Quartz Ekhesi and a few others to try to do what has been called impossible by many, Overthrow Ikistar's Corrupt Government and free the country from the wrath of "The Dictator" who keeps his name private, You'll go through 4 islands and even go up to space to do this "Impossible task" You're this countries only hope
